warning: Sanitized historical example. Not installation authority or current inventory.

example.versionPolicy: Checksum-pinned initial DMG; later vendor updates must preserve bundle identity, Team ID, strict deep signature, Gatekeeper acceptance and numeric build floor 87. Display version is not parsed as numeric.
example.dataBoundary: GameToMac owns its user-space runtime, Steam and game data. Never read or record Steam credentials, tokens, user saves or game content. Login, Steam Guard and any permission prompts remain owner-operated.
example.smoke: bin/check-gametomac --installed plus successful visible GameToMac library launch; CS2 gameplay is separately verified after owner Steam login and download.
example.removal: Reviewed enabled=false successor through the same exact-build typed broker path removes only the attested managed app and marker. Preserve all user data.
example.rollback: Retain preceding generation. On failed install use owned staging cleanup; if post-apply checks fail, review and apply an enabled=false successor. Never delete application support, Steam or game files.
example.idempotence: Repeat exact accepted apply without a new generation; signed vendor app at or above build floor is retained.
